parent_objective: audit support-first reset-validation result before measured execution design
blocked_by: M1869 reset-only validation pass requires audit before measured execution design
supersedes: direct measured execution after reset preflight

public_gates: M1870 must audit M1869 reset result counts label distribution sampling failures and guardrails
M1870 must decide measured execution design versus task-quality/source-balance repair
M1870 must not run measured rollout training replay PPO ranking paper-level or level3 claims

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits clean reset-only support before measured execution design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: reset-validation result audit only; no rollout, measured rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1869 result_class is not pass
stop if any reset sampling failures exist
stop if label leakage or ranking admission exists
stop if measured execution would be admitted without explicit design
fallback_plan: route to measured execution design if reset result is clean and imbalance is acceptable
route to task-quality/source-balance repair if reset result is clean but panel balance is unacceptable
route to reset sampler repair if sampling failures exist

admission_evidence: M1869 summary exists and reports reset preflight pass
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1870 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for measured execution design or repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; reset-validation result audit is task-quality infrastructure.
history_necessity_tests: Audit must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1869 reset rows only; no rollout.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset validation is not clean, route to repair rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, measured rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The clean M1869 reset-only validation result is sufficient to admit measured execution design over the support-first payload.
success_criteria: audit checks result_class counts sampling failures label distribution and guardrails
audit chooses measured execution design or repair route
no rollout measured rollout training replay PPO ranking or paper-level claim is made
failure_criteria: audit ignores failed counts or guardrails
audit runs rollout or measured rollout
audit routes directly to controller ranking
audit changes actor inputs reward dynamics or termination behavior
decision_rule: M1870 passes if it audits M1869 and routes to measured execution design or repair without running rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
